name: Bahnhof AB (publ)
summary: Bahnhof AB (publ) operates as a prominent internet and telecommunications service provider, active throughout Sweden and other European countries. The company offers a diverse portfolio of services, encompassing high-speed broadband, traditional telephony, and a range of hosting options including server, virtual private server, and comprehensive cloud solutions. For digital security, Bahnhof supplies VPN, antivirus protection, and identity safeguarding. Their consumer-focused offerings also feature play and streaming services. Catering to businesses, they provide specialized solutions such as wireless office WiFi, WAN, and SD-WAN. Additionally, Bahnhof delivers critical backbone and carrier services, like network capacity, wavelength connectivity, IP transit, and SIP services, aimed at enterprise clients and fellow operators. Their extensive IT services also cover datacenter management, tailored IT operations, expert consultancy, robust data security, and colocation facilities. Founded in 1994, Bahnhof AB (publ) is based in Stockholm, Sweden, and operates as a subsidiary of KN Telecom AB.
